notes: §2002:13.16.49.3 GR2: storage-section SELECT WHEN clauses have no effect. In a record-less CODE-SET file, WRITE FILE F FROM a working-storage record and READ INTO a local-storage record, each with a false SELECT WHEN, succeed with 00 (no 45) and convert by the FROM description; the linkage record behaves normally. The --std 2002 run on the pinned build matched.
